profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Used Django to extract client data from various databases which was used to build various machine learning models. The machine learning models that were built included a recommendation system that predicted what metrics a client would use and what dashboards a client could use. 

Additionally, updated a website clients use to interact with data. This allowed clients to have a faster streamlined process when accessing important data relevant to them.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Focused on providing predictive models using machine learning. Used these models to predict turnaround time and to predict if an engineer was likely to complete a given task during a set amount of time.
